saga.dragonballultimate.wind_map.title: Wind Map
saga.dragonballultimate.wind_map.descrip: Lume is charting a safe route through the valley. Visit the eastern lookout, then the western lookout. Bring both wind readings back to Lume.
saga.dragonballultimate.fog_signals.desc: Fog has covered the trail. Find the signal keeper to confirm the lantern code, then tell Lume what you learned.
saga.dragonballultimate.beacon_vigil.des: Check with the beacon keeper that the route is ready for travelers. File your report with Lume.
saga.dragonballultimate.message.all_done: You completed all available quests with this mentor.
saga.dragonballultimate.message.unavaila: This character has no quest for you right now.
